title: MZ A Celestial Weapon: MZ Edition

posts.author: MoonWolfV
posts.body:
A Celestial Weapon: MZ Edition
AI Notice: A Celestial Weapon: MZ Edition uses AI Graphics in several parts of the game. This includes the title screen, a couple of images for cutscenes, and a battle background. All AI Graphics are included in the screenshots section. No other use of AI is present or was used in the game.
Plot
​
Soldaria, a militaristic nation which has been at war with it's peace-loving neighbour Senecia for the last 30 years.
One night, the resident skeptic of the Soldarian capital city of Canaburg, Sophie, sees an object fall out of the night sky. The official government reports say that this was simply a meteor, but naturally, Sophie doesn't believe a word of that. With her friend and fellow skeptic, James, and their new friend who just happens to work for the government, Vincent - they soon find in the government archives that this was indeed no meteor. This was a sabotage act by Soldarian agents!
With this knowledge, and the designs for the information obtained from such an act, Sophie and her friends make their way to Senecia as quick as they can. Can they warn the Senecian government of what is to come, before the beautiful, but equally cruel General Felchers can turn her sun-gun or heliobeam upon Senecia? Destroying them for nothing but her cruel satisfaction?
Features
​
All characters have their tech skills they can use in battle. Each is unique, Sophie's "Trigger Happy" lets her attack many times in a single turn. Heather and James can increase their magic power and physical attack power. - And who knows what is going to come when Tania uses her "Super Skill" ability?
Hawsers experiments have become much more fleshed out, no more just some weird blue elf things, say hello to the Aviettes.
New flashback sequences.
Everything has a major graphics upgrade. As to be expected moving from Rpg Maker 2003 to Rpg Maker MZ.
Tania is no longer a one-trick pony, where all she used to be able to do was "Steal"... and that was it.
An obscure Monty Python reference is hidden away in the game. See if you can find the nod to the film "The Meaning of Life".
And for those who have looked at the screenshots, and have played the "kind of a sequel - as in set in the same world but a few years later", Every Vote Counts. That Io you see there, yes, that's the same Io in Every Vote Counts.
Download
A Celestial Weapon MZ Edition can be downloaded from itch.io
https://moonwolfv.itch.io/a-celestial-weapon-mz-edition
Images
​
Jodie Felchers: No longer the ugly-monster she was in the original "A Celestial Weapon"
Those irritating combination locked chests are a thing of the past. They are now simply "locked", find a key to open them in the nearby area.
A nod to George Orwell's 1984 and it's Victory Gin.
